$comment: Single source of truth for every colour in the app. Consumed by theme/tokens.ts (typed, feeds the MUI theme) and by scripts/contrast-check.mjs (verifies the pairs in CONTRAST_PAIRS). Never hardcode a colour in a component; see CLAUDE.md 8.3.

accent.$comment: D1 asks for the brand cyan as the accent hue with a darker shade where contrast demands it. White on the raw brand #00AAB9 measures 2.82:1, so in light mode the FILL is the darker shade and `brand` is kept for decoration only (bars, badges, logo) where no text sits on top.

text.$comment: muted was #737373 to match the old palette, but that is 3.36:1 on the panel -- below the 4.5:1 AA floor for text. #898989 is the closest grey that passes (4.55:1 panel, 5.17:1 canvas). The same #737373 is kept for border.interactive, which is non-text and only needs 3:1.

document.$comment: Mode-invariant: a PDF page and a spreadsheet grid ARE the document, so they stay light in dark mode (CLAUDE.md 8.3). Highlights must therefore pass contrast on white in both modes.
